September 19, 1971
2014-12-12T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/september-19-1971-54692

The basic problems with East Pakistan will not be solved without a political resolution, says UN Secretary General U Thant. He urges the citizens of the world to help about the matter, a BBC report says.

Pakistan army started a ‘genocide’ in East Pakistan, this statement is a sheer lie, says PDP Chief Mahmud Ali in Karachi. Because military operations do not create any such incident so that a strong term like ‘Genocide’ has to be used, he adds.

By-elections will be held for 78 seats in East Pakistan National Council and for 105 seats in Provincial Council from November 25 to December 9, Pakistan Election Commission declares.
